newsitem.title: USA: CompuCom sees slower profit growth.
newsitem.headline: CompuCom sees slower profit growth.

text.p: CompuCom Systems Inc said on Thursday it expected revenue growth to remain strong as it explored new markets though earnings growth could be reduced for six to nine months.

The company, which sells desktop computers and network integration services to corporate customers, opened a 305,000 square-foot facility in New Jersey that triples its custom configuration and distribution capabilities.
CompuCom said it introduced a network aggregator program for value-added resellers, and it was hiring and training more system engineers for its services business.
